answer: A juror that skips cases loses 31% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. Because the river decay is applied at each close, the garden audit makes public the reduced weight and the seat has to be earned again. A farm that parks keys in the jury pool hence watches its influence decay while paying the spiral fee to keep them eligible. Honest users pay that once, farms 35 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
